# Dayan Agent Skills

> Open skills, harnesses, hooks, and verifiers for making probabilistic AI work more repeatable, inspectable, and human-friendly.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Kosmoray/dayan-agent-skills
Live Dayan Deck demo: https://kosmoray.github.io/dayan-agent-skills/
License: MIT
Release: 0.2.0-beta.1

## Available Skills

- Dayan Deck: turns structured content into a self-contained HTML presentation with one narrative job per slide, a coherent visual system, editable text, and a deterministic structural verifier.
- Dayan Adversarial Reviewer: reviews a bounded engineering change through failure-mode, maintainability, and trust-boundary lenses, then returns evidence-backed Markdown and machine-verifiable JSON.

## Verified

- catalog and plugin manifests parse;
- fourteen-plus positive and negative tests pass;
- isolated packaging into Codex and Claude Code Skill directories passes;
- the example deck passes its structural verifier;
- public redline scanning is part of CI.

## Not claimed

- universal behavioral compatibility across agent versions;
- verified PPTX export;
- visual quality from structural tests alone;
- suitability for consequential decisions without human review.

## Roadmap

Create: Huashu Design, Dayan HTML, Diagram.
Think: Wenzhen, Plan, Orient.
Build: Agent Designer, Agent Factory, Hook Factory.
Verify & Grow roadmap: AI SEO.
